    Runs on an embedded SQLite engine (works offline) with a Snowflake dialect layer: QUALIFY, IFF, DIV0, NVL, DATEADD/DATEDIFF/DATE_TRUNC, ::casts, VARIANT paths + LATERAL FLATTEN, GENERATOR, MINUS, IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM, MEDIAN, PERCENTILE_CONT, COUNT_IF, lateral aliases. Snowflake-only operations (MERGE, Time Travel, CLONE, COPY, PIVOT, MATCH_RECOGNIZE) are explained in the guided lab.
